topic: Engine Health monitoring by using vibration analysis
syllabus_extract: Engine Health monitoring by using vibration analysis
specific_objectives: 26.1.1.7 Trainee will be able to explain vibration analysis EHM Technique

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Vibration Spectra Charts; Instructor supervision required for interpretation of frequency bands
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of Engine Health Monitoring?
List three common methods used for engine condition monitoring.
Define the term 'Vibration Analysis' in the context of EHM.

development.content:
Fundamentals of Vibration Analysis
Sources of Engine Vibration
Frequency Domain Analysis
Time Domain Parameters
Thresholds and Alarm Levels

Interpretation of Spectra Charts
Identification of Imbalance and Misalignment
Detection of Bearing Defects
Analysis of Gear Mesh Frequencies
Trend Analysis for Predictive Maintenance

Integration with EHM Systems
Data Logging and Reporting Procedures
Limitations of Vibration Analysis
Correlation with Power Performance Checks
Role of Maintenance Technicians

summary_questions: Explain how vibration signatures indicate specific engine faults.
Describe the relationship between vibration data and power performance checks.
Outline the steps involved in reporting vibration anomalies to maintenance.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how vibration analysis data supports the transition to LP 09 regarding Power Performance Checks.
